name: teder-leads
doc: Toran's lead page asks Teder about the same store, builds its Teder demo, and marks the Teder lead sent when one message from our number carried both demos (the owner, 2026-11-08: "i want the admin lead page to be connected. i want to be able to build only toran or only teder for a page, or both. i want to be able to send them 2 demos or 1"). Teder src/web/leads-internal.js serves it, Toran src/ops/tederLeads.ts calls it. It is between Teder and Toran alone, so this file is kept byte for byte the same in both repositories' test/fixtures, and each side's test reads it. A lead is found by Toran's store id, else by its domain (www. left out). ok false is a refusal the operator reads (error, in Hebrew), never a failure of the route.
auth: Authorization: Bearer <OF_INTERNAL_TOKEN>, from this machine only, never through Caddy

common.case: OF_INTERNAL_TOKEN is not set on Teder
not from this machine, or through Caddy
no token, or a wrong one
a request that is not one: a toran id that is not [A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}, no toran id and no domain, a store with no domain, a stage that is not first or reminder, a body that is not a JSON object

answers.case: Teder has the store: its stage (new, demo_ready, sent, opened, replied, joined, irrelevant), whether its one reminder is due, and its demo (status new, building, ready, failed, approved or removed; pageUrl once approved; error when failed; reviewUrl, the demo's page in Teder)
the store is a lead now and its demo is being built (or an earlier demo of its domain was linked)

body.message: בונים את הדמו. זה לוקח כמה דקות.

answers.case: refused: one of our customers' sites, a store that asked not to be written to, one that already has a demo, or one being built now
marked as "שלחתי" marks it, via whatsapp
refused: no such lead, its demo is not up (first), no reminder to send or not its time yet (reminder)
